meaning: Source/document review attestations, not proof of semantic correctness or issue completion.

agents.review_note: Reviewed official Google typed RetryInfo and QuotaFailure, Vercel AI SDK step telemetry and OpenTelemetry error conventions; native bounded metadata, exact delay and tool-continuation tests; direct advertised-tool prompt guidance.

auth.review_note: Canonical configured username or email matches only the existing owner identity, still requiring password_verify. No credential changes or default password introduced.

commerce.review_note: Reviewed backend skill and commerce data contracts; read-only model-selected facts do not change payment, order, catalogue or checkout writes.

content.review_note: Reviewed browser snapshot bounds, per-owner and page key, revision conflict, explicit save token cleanup and unchanged MySQL CAS and publication status.

foundation.review_note: Reviewed the controller and fixture changes. The existing media service owns reference checks and MySQL and file mutations, with no new runtime data store.

google-tags.review_note: Reviewed integration retry copy; existing analytics and reporting settings unchanged.

http-errors.review_note: Reviewed shared request failure docs and backend skill; unavailable inference is an explicit saved agent error; HTTP boundary handler unchanged.

interface.review_note: Verified the Media Library controls and review screen against Design.md in desktop and 375 px Chromium.

mail.review_note: Reviewed the AdminController diff against the queued mail flow. The new media-only action does not enqueue, process or display mail.

mcp-clients.review_note: Reviewed shared provider transport telemetry; authorized MCP protocols and business tool permissions unchanged.

media.review_note: Checked selection validation, quarantine rollback, referenced-file handling and per-item results against the media deletion guide.

operator-help.review_note: Compared the Media Library controls and two-step deletion results with the uploaded-image operator guide.

public-mcp.review_note: Compared the project route registry with the public MCP transport guide. The additional POST route stays owner-authenticated and does not appear in public MCP profiles.

remote-commerce.review_note: Checked the Design.md addition and current checkout architecture. The new review pattern applies to admin uploads and does not change cart or checkout controls.

sales-channels.review_note: Compared MediaService changes with merchant-feed image resolution. Selection review does not alter catalogue image metadata, URLs or feed output.

workflow.review_note: Verified that the route registry and admin skill describe an authenticated POST with a reviewed and consumed selection. The release and documentation procedures still apply.
